about: BV1 resource-variable admission. TestBindMappingProperty generates Go method sets and checks the binding against the interop table.

mutants.name: BV1 resource variables remain refused
mutants.rule: Resource-typed package variables are admitted as borrows.

mutants.name: BV1 any Close result makes a resource
mutants.rule: Close must return nothing or error alone.

mutants.name: BV1 package pointers silently promise non-nil
mutants.rule: A variable can be nil; map a resource pointer to Option[go.Ref[T]].

mutants.name: gobind-w1-extras-dropped
mutants.rule: A portable package's binding states the build platforms past the binding platforms (windows/amd64, js/wasm, wasip1/wasm), so a program importing it builds there.

mutants.name: gobind-w1-extras-unchecked
mutants.rule: A binding does not state a build platform where its declarations differ from the binding platforms'.

mutants.name: gobind-w1-std-widened
mutants.from: return bindOn(dir, env, v, Platforms, paths)
mutants.rule: Go's standard-library bindings state the binding platforms only, as generated (an import of one off them is S104).
